slides.title: What is drought doing to Ethiopia's crops?
hectares of crops lost
slides.body: June-September rains came up to four weeks late (El Niño), an IFRC report says.

slides.title: people affected
slides.body: in 101 hard-hit districts across six regions. 28,629 livestock lost and 319+ water points dried up.

slides.title: Response so far
slides.body: The Ethiopian Red Cross plans to reach 50,000 people over six months. The report says current aid is not enough. A national assessment is under way.

slides.title: Fund drought aid. Reach every affected district.
